story_clusters.headline: Erdoğan conducts diplomatic outreach on Ukraine-Russia peace and regional conflicts
story_clusters.summary: President Erdoğan held meetings with Putin, Zelensky, and NATO Secretary-General Rutte over the weekend to promote diplomatic solutions to the Ukraine-Russia war and address regional security concerns amid the Iran conflict.

story_clusters.headline: Opinion polls show Erdoğan's approval declining, trailing opposition figures
story_clusters.summary: Multiple polls indicate President Erdoğan's support has dropped significantly from his 2023 election performance, with surveys showing him trailing potential opposition candidates like İmamoğlu and Mansur Yavaş by substantial margins.

story_clusters.headline: İmamoğlu corruption trial continues with partial releases, political controversy persists
story_clusters.summary: İstanbul mayor İmamoğlu's corruption trial saw 18 defendants released while he and other mayors remain detained. The case continues amid claims of politically-motivated prosecution and debates over its legitimacy.

story_clusters.headline: Erdoğan launches 5G technology nationwide, emphasizing digital independence
story_clusters.summary: President Erdoğan officially activated 5G technology across Turkey's 81 provincial centers, stating it will strengthen communication infrastructure and boost the country's digital independence and economic development.

story_clusters.headline: Central Bank and Treasury deny Reuters report on interest rate policy communications
story_clusters.summary: Both TCMB and Treasury Ministry issued statements denying Reuters reports that officials provided private guidance to investors about interest rate policies during London meetings, calling such claims false.

story_clusters.headline: MHP leader Bahçeli calls for accelerating 'Terror-free Turkey' legal framework
story_clusters.summary: MHP leader Devlet Bahçeli stated that conditions are now suitable for implementing legal arrangements for the 'Terror-free Turkey' process, calling for swift passage of related legislation while criticizing CHP over corruption allegations.

story_clusters.headline: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan visits Syria for trilateral talks with Ukrainian and Syrian leaders
story_clusters.summary: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan traveled to Damascus for meetings with Syrian officials and participated in trilateral discussions with Syrian President Ahmed Şara and Ukrainian President Zelensky, focusing on bilateral relations and regional security issues.

story_clusters.headline: CHP leader Özel calls for early elections, denies US property allegations
story_clusters.summary: CHP leader Özgür Özel launched a campaign for early elections while vehemently denying media allegations that he and İmamoğlu purchased US properties, challenging authorities to prove such claims.

story_clusters.headline: DEM Party rejects CHP's early election proposal, outlines conditions for İmralı process
story_clusters.summary: DEM Party rejected CHP's call for early elections, saying it's not on their agenda. The party also shared messages from İmralı meetings about the 'Terror-free Turkey' process and called for concrete democratic steps.

story_clusters.headline: İstanbul police arrest three suspects in major counterfeit currency operation
story_clusters.summary: Police arrested three people in İstanbul following raids that uncovered over $1.2 million in fake US dollars and €655,000 in counterfeit euros, along with equipment used for producing fake currency in residential workshops.

story_clusters.headline: AKP announces Nevruz to become official holiday following Erdoğan's directive
story_clusters.summary: AKP announced that Nevruz will be declared an official holiday in Turkey, with the party stating this decision comes under President Erdoğan's leadership and will soon gain legal status.

story_clusters.headline: MİT captures fugitive spy after 15-year manhunt at Syria-Lebanon border
story_clusters.summary: Turkey's National Intelligence Organization captured fugitive intelligence officer Önder Sığırcıklıoğlu at the Syria-Lebanon border after a 15-year manhunt. The operation was conducted jointly with Syrian intelligence services.
